trigger.observed_after_running_frozen_starts: Both starts optimized successfully, but the best full-data fit did not meet the original NIST parameter and RSS tolerances

certified_forward_rule.purpose: Evaluate the native Fourier equation directly at the NIST certified parameters on all 168 observations to distinguish formula correctness from optimizer reproduction; no fitting is performed for this check
certified_forward_rule.rss_rule: Sum squared residuals from direct certified-parameter predictions and compare with certified_rss using the original rss_absolute_tolerance=0.000001
certified_forward_rule.validation: The forward RSS check must pass; the original optimizer mismatch must remain recorded separately
